profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Citreno | MSSE @ SJSU
profile.summary: I am a Curious software engineering graduate student passionate about building high-quality software products with one year of background in developing software solutions. I am interested in Software Development and Databases. During my undergrad, I worked on several projects like Elective Subject Allocation System and Faculty Information System. I have also worked at Crest Data Systems for over a year, where I worked on Several projects, which include skills like Data Analysis and ELK Stack. Summing up, I am an individual who has a deep interest in algorithms with good communication skills, leadership skills, and the dedication to grab every opportunity.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Headed a high-performing team at Crest to drive the development of security automation solutions for Google’s SIEM platform.
• Collaborated cross-functionally with Google to identify and address critical security gaps, optimizing incident response time through the integration of automated security alerts.
• Implemented efficient log normalization techniques, streamlining log management processes. Achieved a 30% reduction in manual effort by pushing for automation of log normalization processes.
• Recognized for exceptional technical expertise and leadership, contributing to the successful implementation of security automation solutions and achieving notable improvements in log processing accuracy.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Demonstrated proficiency in utilizing ELK Stack and Splunk to analyze and monitor security logs, resulting in a 30% improvement in identifying potential security incidents.
• Actively contributed to the security automation initiatives for Google’s SIEM platform, Google Chronicle.
• Streamlined log ingestion and analysis by 40% through the implementation of efficient data parsing techniques.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Led team of 5 and implemented Sockets, Cron jobs, Redis and Celery to improve project automation and scalability.
• Optimized queries and placed Triggers to ensure the consistency and integrity of MongoDB data.
• Deployed the application on 4 nodes of EC2 with load balancing capable of handling 15000+ requests in less than a minute and containerized the application using Docker.

projects.title: My Elective Mate
projects.description:
• Designed and developed a responsive web portal with adaptive quizzes using HTML, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL. • Added customizable parameters, boosting user satisfaction by 25% and enhancing personalized learning.
• Used adaptive algorithms, reducing completion time by 40% and enhancing knowledge assessment accuracy.

projects.title: Tripwise
projects.description:
• Designed and developed a Travel Planning and Booking System using Python, Django, and React.
• Implemented MongoDB for efficient data management and recommendation algorithms, boosting user satisfaction
by 25%.
• Achieved a 15% increase in user retention and positive feedback, demonstrating effective collaboration.
